exclusions.reason: Root-level skill + manifest validation CLI is exercised directly by the 'Validate skills' CI job (`node scripts/validate-skills.cjs`) and its dedicated unit test; its CLI/error-exit branches run outside the Desk MCP coverage runner.

The runner starts subject and judge processes and is exercised only through the CLI, as child processes, by scripts/test-skill-evals.cjs in the 'offline eval tests' CI job; a child process writes no line coverage into the Desk MCP coverage runner.
